why_a_new_baseline: CON-018 was amended on 2026-10-17 (CARD-222): outside 0.375 -> 0.5 in, top -> 0.55 in, bottom -> 0.47 in, the gutter unchanged at 0.5 in. A proof page is the book's own sheet, so all three moves reach it: the top and bottom margins move every mark down and shorten the drawing on every one of these nine trims, and the stored outside margin moves the right-aligned drawing sideways. Every trim's pages therefore differ from CARD-204's recording, which is what this file records. The 8.25 in square trim is absent from this corpus and is now refused outright (tests/test_book_proof_pages.py's REFUSED_TRIMS_CM carries that measurement).
warning: Never regenerated to make a test pass. A proof page that stops matching this file is either a deliberate change — which earns its own successor, with its own note — or a regression.
